questions.explain: S is the number of cells in series, mAh the capacity, C the discharge current as a multiple of capacity: 1.3 Ah × 100C = 130 A according to the label.

questions.q: When is Li-Ion a better choice than LiPo?
questions.explain: Li-Ion gives more energy per gram but delivers lower currents. For wings and long-range 7–10" that means more minutes in the air.

questions.q: Why does the low-voltage warning trigger on a punch, while the voltage is normal after landing?
options: Wrong battery type in the settings
questions.explain: Voltage under load = EMF − I × R. At high current the sag is instantaneous; once the load is removed, the voltage recovers.

questions.q: At what voltage per cell is LiPo stored?
questions.explain: Storing a full battery for weeks degrades it and leads to swelling. The charger's Storage mode is about 3.8 V/cell.

questions.q: How do you estimate flight time?
questions.explain: Usable capacity is about 80% of the rating, and the average current is taken from the log. Never run the battery down to zero.

questions.q: The VTX reboots on throttle. What do you check first?
questions.explain: Sag on the BEC rail or power from a pad with insufficient current is the typical cause of peripherals rebooting under load.
